items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: he had an apartment down in the Village, and his name was Timmy Rosenkrantz, and Timmy had a very expensive equipment down there in his apartment. And he used to bring Errol Garner down there and just record him by the hour

ctx.x: Somebody said there was a building where an awful lot of recording took place. You'd make a record in one small studio, and you'd walk out in the hall and somebody would grab you and take you into another studio, and you'd be recording with somebody else. I can't remember (inaudible).

I don't know exactly what building that was, but -- it was -- recording was going on all over that place then, but they had a lot of good studios around there then, you know. The building might not have been much, but the recording facilities were good, you know, and Errol Garner was -- they had a guy around there then that had -- he had an apartment down in the Village, and his name was Timmy Rosenkrantz, and Timmy had a very expensive equipment down there in his apartment.

And he used to bring Errol Garner down there and just record him by the hour, and he'd give him all the liquor he want and anything else he want, have chicks for him down there and food. And when Errol got popular, man, all of this stuff came out in Europe, man. This guy made a fortune.
